The analysis of the breast cancer cohort includes models that evaluate the predictive accuracy of survival risk stratification. The models considered are Cox regression with clinical covariates (cox/clinical), random survival forest with clinical covariates (rsf/clinical), Cox regression with clinical covariates and gene expression (cox/clinical_expression), and random survival forest with clinical covariates and gene expression (rsf/clinical_expression). The results indicate that the Cox regression model with clinical covariates outperforms the other models in terms of concordance indices and integrated Brier scores, with the Cox regression model with clinical and gene expression data showing the best performance in terms of AUCs.
